title: Hasan Piker, the controversial streamer seducing America's radical left
subhed: The 35-year-old has established himself on Twitch as one of the most-followed political commentators in the US. title: Denmark set to allow return of 'physical force' to maintain order in schools
subhed: Since 1967, teachers could only physically intervene with students if their safety or that of others was at risk. Starting in August 2027, they will be allowed to 'hold a student, keep them in place, or take them to another room' if the student disrupts the class.

title: Trauma endures in Paris suburb after police grenade shatters teenager's jaw
subhed: On September 28, 14-year-old Eden suffered a fractured jaw and lost most of his teeth after he was struck in the face by a tear-gas grenade fired at close range, just a few meters from his high school, where a protest was taking place. Students, teachers and parents spoke of their fear, anger and sense of helplessness.
